---
title: Terminal API (VT) support
description: Every sequence in Ghostty's VT reference and whether microterm supports it.
---

<!-- Generated by `cargo run -p xtask -- gen-docs` from crates/mt_term/tests/vt_conformance.toml. Do not edit. -->

microterm is checked against [Ghostty's VT reference](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/reference) and its [external protocols](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/external). Each row below is backed by test cases in `cargo test -p mt_term vt_conformance`.

Status is **supported**, **partial** or **unsupported**; notes say what differs.

78 sequences: 76 supported, 1 partial, 1 unsupported.

## Control characters

| Sequence | Name | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `BEL` | [Bell](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/control/bel) | supported |  |
| `BS` | [Backspace](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/control/bs) | supported |  |
| `TAB` | [Horizontal tab](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/control/tab) | supported |  |
| `LF` | [Line feed](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/control/lf) | supported |  |
| `CR` | [Carriage return](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/control/cr) | supported |  |

## ESC sequences

| Sequence | Name | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ESC 7` | [DECSC](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/esc/decsc) | supported |  |
| `ESC 8` | [DECRC](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/esc/decrc) | supported |  |
| `ESC D` | [IND](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/esc/ind) | supported |  |
| `ESC M` | [RI](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/esc/ri) | supported |  |
| `ESC c` | [RIS](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/esc/ris) | supported |  |
| `ESC =` | [DECKPAM](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/esc/deckpam) | supported |  |
| `ESC >` | [DECKPNM](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/esc/deckpnm) | supported |  |
| `ESC # 8` | [DECALN](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/esc/decaln) | supported |  |

## CSI sequences

| Sequence | Name | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CSI Pn SP q` | [DECSCUSR](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/decscusr) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn A` | [CUU](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/cuu) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn B` | [CUD](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/cud) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn C` | [CUF](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/cuf) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn D` | [CUB](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/cub) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn E` | [CNL](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/cnl) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn F` | [CPL](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/cpl) | supported |  |
| `CSI Py ; Px H` | [CUP](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/cup) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn I` | [CHT](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/cht) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn J` | [ED](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/ed) | partial | `CSI 1 J` with the cursor on the second row leaves the first row intact (alacritty_terminal 0.26 only clears whole rows above when the cursor is below row 1). |
| `CSI Pn K` | [EL](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/el) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn M` | [DL](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/dl) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn L` | [IL](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/il) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn P` | [DCH](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/dch) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn S` | [SU](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/su) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn T` | [SD](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/sd) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn X` | [ECH](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/ech) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn Z` | [CBT](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/cbt) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn a` | [HPR](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/hpr) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn b` | [REP](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/rep) | supported |  |
| `CSI Py d` | [VPA](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/vpa) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn e` | [VPR](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/vpr) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn g` | [TBC](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/tbc) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pn n` | [DSR](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/dsr) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pt ; Pb r` | [DECSTBM](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/decstbm) | supported |  |
| `CSI Pl ; Pr s` | [DECSLRM](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/decslrm) | unsupported | alacritty_terminal has no left/right margins; see docs/adr/0002-decslrm-margins.md. With mode 69 unset `CSI s` stays save-cursor and DECRQM reports mode 69 as not recognised. |
| `CSI ? Pm $ p` | [DECRQM (SGR-pixels, 1016)](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/xtshiftescape) | supported | Only mode 1016 is answered by microterm itself; other private modes are answered by the engine (1015, 47 and 1047 are not implemented and report 0). |
| `CSI > Pn q` | [XTVERSION](https://invisible-island.net/xterm/ctlseqs/ctlseqs.html) | supported | Replies `DCS > \| microterm <version> ST`. Not in Ghostty's reference list; Ghostty answers it the same way. |
| `CSI Pn @` | [ICH](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/ich) | supported |  |
| `CSI Px `` | [HPA](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/hpa) | supported |  |
| `CSI > Pn s` | [XTSHIFTESCAPE](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/csi/xtshiftescape) | supported |  |

## OSC sequences

| Sequence | Name | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `OSC 0` | [Window icon and title](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/0) | supported |  |
| `OSC 1` | [Window icon](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/1) | supported | Accepted and ignored: there is no icon name to show. |
| `OSC 2` | [Window title](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/2) | supported |  |
| `OSC 4` | [Palette colors](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/4) | supported |  |
| `OSC 5` | [Special colors](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/5) | supported |  |
| `OSC 7` | [Working directory](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/7) | supported |  |
| `OSC 8` | [Hyperlink](https://gist.github.com/egmontkob/eb114294efbcd5adb1944c9f3cb5feda) | supported |  |
| `OSC 9` | [Desktop notification](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/9) | supported | `9;4` progress feeds the pane status; other ConEmu subcommands (9;1–9;3, 9;5–9;12) are parsed and ignored. Notifications go through the `[notifications]` pipeline when `terminal.osc_notifications` is on. |
| `OSC 10` | [Foreground color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/1x) | supported |  |
| `OSC 11` | [Background color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/1x) | supported |  |
| `OSC 12` | [Cursor color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/1x) | supported |  |
| `OSC 13` | [Pointer foreground color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/1x) | supported | Stored and answered; no visual effect. |
| `OSC 14` | [Pointer background color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/1x) | supported | Stored and answered; no visual effect. |
| `OSC 15` | [Tektronix foreground color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/1x) | supported | Stored and answered; no visual effect. |
| `OSC 16` | [Tektronix background color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/1x) | supported | Stored and answered; no visual effect. |
| `OSC 17` | [Highlight background color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/1x) | supported | Overrides the selection background for this pane. |
| `OSC 18` | [Tektronix cursor color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/1x) | supported | Stored and answered; no visual effect. |
| `OSC 19` | [Highlight foreground color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/1x) | supported | Overrides the selection foreground for this pane. |
| `OSC 21` | [Kitty color protocol](https://sw.kovidgoyal.net/kitty/color-stack/) | supported | Keys without a visual meaning (`cursor_text`, `visual_bell`, `transparent_background_colorN`) are stored and reported only. Replies use the 8-bit `rgb:rr/gg/bb` form. |
| `OSC 22` | [Pointer shape](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/22) | supported | Names follow the X11 cursor-name list used by xterm and Kitty; a name with no GPUI equivalent shows the arrow. |
| `OSC 52` | [Clipboard data](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/52) | supported | Write is allowed (100 KiB cap) and read is off unless `clipboard.osc52 = "read-write"` (SPEC §6.3). An empty payload clears the clipboard. |
| `OSC 104` | [Reset palette colors](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/104) | supported |  |
| `OSC 105` | [Reset special colors](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/105) | supported |  |
| `OSC 110` | [Reset foreground color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/11x) | supported |  |
| `OSC 111` | [Reset background color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/11x) | supported |  |
| `OSC 112` | [Reset cursor color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/11x) | supported |  |
| `OSC 113` | [Reset pointer foreground color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/11x) | supported |  |
| `OSC 114` | [Reset pointer background color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/11x) | supported |  |
| `OSC 115` | [Reset Tektronix foreground color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/11x) | supported |  |
| `OSC 116` | [Reset Tektronix background color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/11x) | supported |  |
| `OSC 117` | [Reset highlight background color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/11x) | supported |  |
| `OSC 118` | [Reset Tektronix cursor color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/11x) | supported |  |
| `OSC 119` | [Reset highlight foreground color](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/11x) | supported |  |
| `OSC 4 / 104 multi` | [Several colour specs in one sequence](https://ghostty.org/docs/vt/osc/4) | supported | Also covered by the OSC 4 and OSC 104 rows. |
